plan_point: 77.44.7.D — structured authored content and media repeaters

change.summary: Added a table-driven D regression contract for minimum content in list, tabs, accordion, dropdown, gallery, and carousel repeaters. It checks the same invalid state is surfaced by Inspector publication guidance and rejected by the server-side Publish validator, then checks valid replacement content passes both boundaries. Unsafe repeated image sources are also required to fail closed.
change.save_publish: The test covers validation boundaries only; the existing Save and Publish operations remain separate and unchanged.
